contents.README.md:
# MTerm-CLI ChatGPT private plugin v0.2.1

This archive is **plugin source**, not a Windows installer or a guarantee that ChatGPT can install directly from a file. Its endpoint is `https://mcp.m-techlabs.com/mcp`.

## Configure and recover

1. Open the owner-only manager at https://m-techlabs.com/admin/mcp and use **Plugin & recovery** for the latest archive and status.
2. Open the existing private ChatGPT plugin entry at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aed1a85300481919559498b458ed278.
3. Try connecting/authorizing from ChatGPT if offered, and complete Cloudflare Access OAuth with the owner account.
4. If ChatGPT only offers uninstall, retain this archive first; reinstall or re-create the private plugin using the ChatGPT plugin creation workflow available to your account and this archive. The plugin ID might change if you create a new plugin.
5. Start a new chat with the plugin enabled and request `get_file_info` for `H:\MTechLabs\MCP\runtime\package.json`. Only this call validates the end-to-end ChatGPT path.

Do **not** delete the Windows manager, cloudflared, or the manager's config for a ChatGPT-side auth problem. ChatGPT account installation and consent cannot be reset by an MCP server.

Publishing a newer package on the website is a separate step from updating the private plugin in ChatGPT. See the site's package release synchronization documentation.

contents.skills/connection-recovery/SKILL.md:
---
name: mterm-connection-recovery
description: Diagnose the private MTerm-CLI ChatGPT connection and open the owner-only manager for configuration or recovering a broken OAuth installation.
---

# Recover MTerm-CLI safely

1. Distinguish backend health, plugin installation in the present ChatGPT conversation, and authenticated MCP tool-call success. A healthy endpoint alone does not establish working ChatGPT authorization.
2. The owner-only management page is https://m-techlabs.com/admin/mcp. The current private plugin is https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aed1a85300481919559498b458ed278.
3. The server endpoint is https://mcp.m-techlabs.com/mcp, using OAuth and dynamic client registration. Never paste manager tokens into ChatGPT settings or downloads.
4. Browser-side OAuth consent/install is controlled by ChatGPT and Cloudflare Access; MCP tools cannot create a native ChatGPT Settings Reconnect button or bypass consent.
5. Prefer a reconnect if offered; otherwise download a verified package before uninstalling, reinstall from the supported plugin creation flow, then test get_file_info for H:\MTechLabs\MCP\runtime\package.json.
6. Do not change local services or Cloudflare OAuth to work around a missing ChatGPT-side install.
